title: Zero-Free Criteria from Signed Liouville Energies
description: Signed Liouville energies characterize zero-free half-planes for the zeta function. We derive a quantitative weighted-energy certificate and its pole-order boundary cost, together with exact decomposition and Abel-obstruction results. The critical energy upper bound needed for RH and the corresponding Dirichlet GRH bounds remain unproved.
